note: Committed BEFORE the backtest engine was run on any historical sample, so positive hindsight results cannot move these goalposts. All decisions read the CONSERVATIVE (strict-through) fill tier; the optimistic (at-price print-through) tier is an upper bound only and never gates anything. No queue-ignored maker fill is ever labeled realized.

benchmark_anchor.source: live Railway shadow checkpoint 2026-09-02 ~14:45-15:49 UTC (owner-relayed) + public-tape census this session

venue_family_go_criteria.description: A venue/category family is a GO candidate for a continuous read-only shadow adapter only if ALL hold under the conservative fill tier, computed on its backtest sample:
criteria: clean_matched_completions_per_day >= 2x the Gemini BTC-5m baseline under the SAME fill assumption and same q=1 one-attempt-per-event mechanics
median completed pair cost including both maker fees <= 0.99 (>= 1c locked edge)
sample >= 30 qualifying campaigns spanning >= 2 distinct days or independent sessions
residual tail bounded: no single-event worst-case loss above the first-leg cost at q=1 under the venue's settlement rules

flow_gate_adoption_criteria.description: A pre-entry trailing two-sided-flow gate (30s/60s/120s variants) is recommended for forward shadow evaluation only if BOTH hold in the backtest:
criteria: one_sided_holds reduced by >= 50% versus no-gate on the same sample
matched completions lost <= 25% versus no-gate on the same sample
flow_gate_adoption_criteria.note: Backtest support alone never changes code; a passing gate goes to forward shadow comparison first.

labeling_rules: All backtest P&L is THEORETICAL; nothing here is realized
Settlement outcomes inferred from final pre-expiry quotes are labeled outcome_proxy and excluded from P&L when the final mid is inside (0.20, 0.80)
Data tiers are reported separately: tier1 exact quote+print replay, tier2 print-only flow ceiling, tier3 unavailable
